scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @flux/shared && npm run build -w @flux/document-model && npm run build -w @flux/storage
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n web,api,sync -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @flux/web" "npm run dev -w @flux/api" "npm run dev -w @flux/collaboration"
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @flux/api && npm run build -w @flux/collaboration && npm run build -w @flux/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json
